Contains ONLY a functions block — deliberately NO firestore/storage/emulators keys — so a stray deploy with this config can push the functions codebase and NOTHING else; it cannot reach a ruleset or an index. Shipping it INERT: the file existing does not deploy anything, and the deploy itself is a MANUAL, coordinated human step in the migration window (window item W9, root `CLAUDE.md` rule 8) — agents never run `firebase deploy`. ⚠️ Step 3's PR 3-e adds the CI lane's emulator config `firebase.amazon.tasks.json` one dot apart from this file: only THIS one deploys, so read the whole filename before any deploy. The predeploy hook runs tools/deploy-env/preflight.mjs FIRST (which ABORTS on a missing TASKS_INVOKER_SA or FUNCTIONS_REGION, or a region without Cloud Tasks) and then apps/amazon/functions/scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs, which esbuild-bundles the functions + writes a MINIMAL workspace-free package.json. The functions need FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID + admin creds in their env, plus AMAZON_LWA_CLIENT_SECRET in Secret Manager BEFORE the deploy (a declared secret that is missing fails the whole deploy). Deploy: firebase deploy --only functions:amazon --config firebase.amazon.deploy.json --project <id>. See apps/amazon/functions/DEPLOY.md.
